dominant_strengths: Impeccable SF typography hierarchy with the oversized 'iPhone' wordmark anchoring the page with confident restraint
Crisp product silhouettes against pure white create museum-grade craft visibility and let device colors carry the palette
Navigation, lineup row, and explore grid follow a disciplined modular rhythm consistent with Apple's global design system
dominant_weaknesses: Lineup thumbnails read as a uniform sticker strip — limited scale variation flattens the visual hierarchy below the title
Promo trade-in banner uses dense legal-style copy that clashes tonally with the otherwise minimal, emotionally cool composition
Innovation is near zero; this is template execution, indistinguishable from prior years aside from product swaps
fix_priorities: Differentiate the hero/featured model in the lineup row via scale or color framing to break the uniform tile cadence
Tighten the trade-in banner copy and typographic weight so it feels like a curated offer, not retail clutter
Introduce subtle motion or parallax on the explore-the-lineup cards to elevate reflective delight beyond static catalog
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral clarity dominates with effortless wayfinding, visceral appeal is solid via product photography, but reflective resonance is muted by formulaic repetition.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes — it cleanly fulfills the Apple iPhone landing brief with native system fidelity, though it prioritizes operational consistency over surprise.
